tools.name: rank_countries
tools.description: Rank the 30 tracked European countries on one metric (cheapest power, cleanest grid, AI Power Index, data center count, etc.). Returns rank, value and links.

tools.name: get_country
tools.description: Full electricity profile of one European country for AI infrastructure: mix, carbon intensity, industrial and wholesale prices, data centers, grid operators, climate, and an editorial grid-access outlook.

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Side-by-side key metrics for 2 to 6 European countries: carbon intensity, low-carbon share, industrial price, AI Power Index.

tools.name: estimate_ai_campus_power
tools.description: Estimate yearly electricity use, power bill (at Eurostat industrial prices) and CO2 for an AI data center of a given IT load, in one country or ranked across all countries.

tools.name: list_ai_campuses
tools.description: Announced and under-construction AI data center campuses in Europe (tracker with a primary source per project). Filter by country, status or minimum MW.

tools.name: get_grid_access
tools.description: How many GW of data centres (or large loads) are queuing for a grid connection in each European country, compared with the country's average load, plus what the grid operator is doing (paused, fees, auctions, maturity tests). Every row has a source. Filter by country or policy status.

tools.name: define_term
tools.description: Plain-English definition of a European grid, power-market or data center term (e.g. PUE, TSO, PPA, grid queue, curtailment).

tools.name: get_latest_report
tools.description: The latest 'State of European AI power' monthly report: five key findings plus wholesale prices, AI Power Index leaders, campus pipeline, grid carbon and industrial prices.

tools.name: compare_world
tools.description: EU-27 compared with the United States and China: electricity generation, demand, mix, carbon intensity and data center counts.
